name: design-system-gen
description: Generate a complete design token system for a new project — color palette, typography scale, spacing, shadows, and border radius — tailored to the product type (SaaS, e-commerce, healthcare, fintech, creative, etc.). Use when starting a new project with no design system, when the user asks to "set up design tokens", "create a design system", or "what colors/fonts should I use for a [product type]". Do NOT use when the project already has tokens — use ui-redesign instead.
